title: FOLDING TOP LOCK ASM.
summary: Convertible (19467) soft top front latches: the three locks (LH, center, RH paddle latches) in the folding top's front bow that clamp it to the windshield header, the header guides (alignment pins) on the windshield header, and the trim panel under the front bow. Locks are bolted into the front bow from the front (shimmed as required), the bracket and trim panel are screwed to the bow, and the guides are screwed up into the header. Locks are adjusted for a 13-16 lb release load at the paddle.
